title: 💾 MSFS 2024 Sim Update 3: DOWNLOADS vs PERFORMANCE! Worth It? ✈️
description:
Sim Update 3 for Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024 has landed, bringing granular control over your downloaded content! 🌍 But what's the REAL cost to your performance and bandwidth? 🤔

In this video, we dive deep into the new package management system:
✅ How to DOWNLOAD new content seamlessly.
🔄 How to UPDATE existing packages.
🗑️ How to REMOVE unwanted content to save space.

Then, we put it to the test with TWO crucial comparisons:
1️⃣ Cessna 172 Low & Slow: Departing London City Airport (EGLC) for a scenic flight over the City and the Thames. We'll monitor FPS and bandwidth with and without key packages. 🏙️
2️⃣ Boeing 787-10 High & Heavy: Taking off from London Heathrow (EGLL) to see how package downloads affect performance on a complex airliner. 🛫

Is downloading everything the best strategy, or will a lean install keep your frames high and data usage low? Watch to find out! 👇 Don't forget to hit that like button, share your thoughts in the comments, and subscribe for more MSFS 2024 content! 🔔
